items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I was with my friend, the bass player - a guy named von Pfister --- George von Pfister

ctx.x: Tom Wing was the Chinese man .

Yeah - the last time we worked there - we only worked two weeks - then they had the the offer for the Rendezvous -- well, when we went to the Rendezvous; this is the most high class nightclub in all of Chicago and it had an outside garden; a beautiful, beautiful room inside and a big bandstand way above the floor and, oh, it was lovely. And, uh, I thought -- well, gee, let's go hear the band before we open up -- I was with my friend, the bass player - a guy named von Pfister --- George von Pfister, and we went to…
I know who it was--- but go ahead and tell---
